---
title: "Sprott D System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y \\
\dot{y} &=& x+z \\
\dot{z} &=& xz+ay^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=3$ and initial condition $(-1,-1,2)$.
